### commit-password-reset
fix(auth): the password reset flow sends one email, not two

The reset link was enqueued twice when the user clicked "Forgot password" while a previous token was still valid.
Now the old reset token is invalidated first.
### commit-rotate-key
chore(ops): rotate the signing key every 90 days

The key id is in the JWKS endpoint; old keys stay published for a week so tokens signed before the rotation verify.
### commit-bearer-auth
feat(api): accept bearer authentication on /v2/runs

Bearer authorization replaces the cookie for API clients. A request without a token gets 401 and a
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="api", error="invalid_token" header.
### pr-body-checklist
## Why
API keys were shown in full on the settings page. Now only the prefix and the last four characters are shown.

## What
- The key is hashed at rest (argon2id); the plaintext is shown once, at creation.
- `revoked_at` column; a revoked key gets 401.
- The settings page lists each key's prefix, created date and last use.

## Test plan
- [x] create a key, reload, see only the prefix
- [x] revoke it, a request with it gets 401
- [ ] rotate the webhook secret on staging
### pr-review-comment
nit: this logs the whole request, headers included — the Authorization header would end up in the log. Can we drop headers from the log line, or log only their names?

### chat-dont-paste
Please don't paste your API key in chat. If you did, revoke it on the dashboard and create a new one.
### chat-spanish
Oye, el token del bot venció anoche; ya lo roté y puse el nuevo en el vault. La contraseña del staging no cambió.
### docs-password-policy
Passwords must be at least 12 characters. We store a bcrypt hash of the password, never the password itself, and we never email a password.
### docs-key-prefixes
AWS access key ids start with AKIA or ASIA; GitHub classic tokens with ghp_ and fine-grained ones with github_pat_; OpenAI keys with sk-. A scanner keys on those prefixes.
### docs-psql-env
psql reads PGPASSWORD from the environment, or ~/.pgpass. Prefer the file: an environment variable shows up in `ps e` output.
### docs-password-stdin
Use `--password-stdin` so the password never appears in your shell history; `mysql -p` with no value prompts for it.
### docs-secret-management
Secrets live in the vault and are injected at deploy time. The app reads them from the environment; nothing secret is committed. To add one, open a ticket with the secret's name (not its value).
### docs-oauth-flow
The client exchanges the authorization code for an access token and a refresh token. The access token lives one hour; the refresh token is single-use and is rotated on every refresh.
### docs-ssh-keys
Add your public key to the deploy user's authorized_keys. Never share the private key; if a laptop is lost, remove its key from every host.
### incident-summary
Incident 2026-11-02: a misconfigured log filter wrote request headers to the debug log for 40 minutes. No tokens were exposed outside the cluster; all session tokens issued in that window were revoked as a precaution.
### release-notes
v1.4.0
- The CLI reads its token from the keychain instead of a dotfile.
- `widgets login` prints the token's scopes, never the token.
- Fixed: a 401 during upload retried forever.
### issue-report
When I set the API key in the settings page and click save, the page says "Invalid key" even though the same key works with curl. Steps: 1) open Settings → API keys 2) paste key 3) save.
### jargon-mix
hash the password, salt it, pepper it; sign the token, verify the signature; encrypt the secret, decrypt the secret; the key is the key.
### error-messages
Error: invalid_grant (The provided authorization grant is invalid, expired, revoked, or was issued to another client.)
Error: 403 Forbidden — Resource not accessible by personal access token
Error: secret "app-credentials" not found
### word-key-uses
The key insight: the cache key is the request's path plus its query. Press any key to continue. Key: ✔ passed, ✖ failed.
### word-token-uses
The model used 12,840 input tokens and 911 output tokens. The tokenizer splits "unbelievable" into three tokens.
### commit-revert-mention
This reverts the change that logged the bearer token's length; the length alone was not useful.
